prompt: A substitute technician takes 9:00, and written approval arrives for 11:00. Each hour-long slot has a live run from twenty to thirty minutes after it starts. Dana can leave as soon as the run ends, but must leave by 11:25. Which is the latest valid booking that lets her see the whole run?
promptZh: 替補設置技術員接手九點，十一點也已收到書面核准。每時段一小時，實機運轉從開始後第二十分鐘持續到第三十分鐘。黛娜可在運轉結束後離開，但最晚十一點二十五分須走。能讓她看完整場運轉、且最晚的有效預約是哪一項？

options.text: Book the whole 9:00 slot; Dana can leave after the run.
options.zh: 預約九點的完整時段；黛娜看完實機運轉即可離開。
options.whyZh: 九點有人且就緒，但十點也符合限制，所以九點不是最晚可行的選項。

options.text: Book the whole 10:00 slot; Dana can leave after the run.
options.zh: 預約十點的完整時段；黛娜看完實機運轉即可離開。
options.whyZh: 十點就緒且人員齊，運轉在十點三十分結束；十一點即使已核准，也要到十一點三十分才能看完。

options.text: Book the whole 11:00 slot; Dana can leave after the run.
options.zh: 預約十一點的完整時段；黛娜看完實機運轉即可離開。
options.whyZh: 人員與核准都符合，但運轉到十一點三十分，黛娜會提早五分鐘離開。

options.text: Book 10:20 to 10:30 only, since Dana does not need to stay for the full hour.
options.zh: 只預約十點二十分到十點三十分，因為黛娜不必待到時段結束。
options.whyZh: 客人可先走，不代表協調員可只預約設備運轉的十分鐘。

explanationZh: 十點就緒且人員齊，運轉在十點三十分結束；十一點即使已核准，也要到十一點三十分才能看完。
evidence: Each customer demonstration needs an operator and a setup technician. / Book the entire slot, even if the machine will run for only part of it. / A slot marked REVIEW is not open for a demonstration until the safety lead sends written approval. / You may offer a READY slot immediately if both roles are covered. / Marta can operate all morning on Wednesday / The technician for 10:00 can still take that slot. / There is also a technician available at 11:00 / The 9:00 and 10:00 slots are listed as READY.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Each customer demonstration needs an operator and a setup technician.
Book the entire slot, even if the machine will run for only part of it.
A slot marked REVIEW is not open for a demonstration until the safety lead sends written approval.
You may offer a READY slot immediately if both roles are covered.
Marta can operate all morning on Wednesday
The technician for 10:00 can still take that slot.
There is also a technician available at 11:00
The 9:00 and 10:00 slots are listed as READY.

vocabulary.note: 本題指示範所需的兩個角色都有人擔任。
